spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.hungry.1: You hold the leash and forget to feed the dog.

spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.hungry.3: Kill something. Or I will choose what.

spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.long_dark.2: Put them all out. Every one.
